subject: colext model summary not displaying estimates

messages.author: 7f38f606dc8116c0
messages.subject: colext model summary not displaying estimates
parts:
Hi everyone, 

I have built a robust model with colext and have run it with no errors. However, the output of the model does not show any estimates: 

> summary(full_mod)

Call:
colext(psiformula = ~1, gammaformula = ~1 + canyon_geometry +
    MSHRUB + PJCON, epsilonformula = ~1 + COLEOGYNE, pformula = ~1,
    data = umf_rob)

Initial (logit-scale):

Colonization (logit-scale):

Extinction (logit-scale):

Detection (logit-scale):


The null model does the same thing. Any ideas on what could be going wrong here? 
When I run confint on the model parameters there are estimates there. 

> confint(full_mod, type = "psi")
             0.025    0.975
psi(Int) 0.3213864 4.084755

Is unmarked just masking them for some reason? I am new to all of this and don't really know where to start to diagnose this issue without there being an error message or anything. 

Thanks for any advice!

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: colext model summary not displaying estimates
parts:
It looks like specifically anything that is displayed using the print() function is not showing up. If you run

print("test")

Do you get "test" in the console, or nothing? I'd suggest starting a fresh R session and run only the minimum code needed to generate the model, to eliminate the possibility that you previously ran some code that has an effect on printing.

Ken
